name: Exposure Score
summary: The pack's convergence page (Nemesis Hound). Fuses every Hound's signal into ONE exposure score per asset — KEV+EPSS+VPR+ACR direct, plus attack path (Fenrir), identity (Janus), AI (Pythia), EOL (Charon), weak/expiring crypto (Certania+Heimdall), ATT&CK (Orthrus) and ownership (Terminus) from tags. Surfaces the worst finding from each Hound and where they converge on the same assets, ranks the estate worst-first, and turns a remediation play into a projected reduction justified by the signals it clears. High-level 'act now' actions; Priority tagging is gated.
